{folder:"20260729-22",name:"Scale Bazaar",area:"game",desc:"A portrait-first market scale puzzle for phones. {folder:"20260727-24",name:"Mirror Market",area:"game",desc:"A portrait-first mirror route puzzle for phones. Study a courier path, reproduce it as a left-right reflection with large direction pads or swipes, chain clean deliveries, unlock Aurora board, and chase your saved best score offline."}

proposed.name: Roomkind Planner
proposed.bottleneck: Rough lot descriptions must be reconciled to storage specs before whole lots can share configurable rooms
proposed.AI: Real MiniLM neural embeddings rank supplied produce references
proposed.distinct: Not nursery scheduling, root-zone water balance, carton geometry, stock expiration rescue or generic linear blending. Exact subset room partition with interval intersections and producer/sensitive exclusion.
